title: Room Hire Standing in a Contracted Event Value
content:
Room rental in a Private Event & Banquet Services contracted value is settled against the food and beverage value the booking entry itself records. The cases below are read in the order given, and the first that answers to the records settles the room hire.

1. Where the food and beverage value standing on the booking entry reaches the room rental waiver spend printed against the package, no room rental stands in the contracted value, and a partial waiver is never given.
2. Where the food and beverage value standing on the booking entry falls short of the minimum food and beverage spend printed against the package, the room rental printed against the package stands in the contracted value together with the difference between that minimum spend and the value standing, which is taken as room hire.
3. Otherwise, the room rental printed against the package stands in the contracted value.

## The three figures each package prints

| Package | Room rental, USD | Waiver reached at, USD | Minimum food and beverage spend, USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Meeting Room Refreshment Package | 0 | 0 | 250 |
| Boardroom Reception Package | 175 | 1500 | 900 |
| Conference Day Delegate Package | 450 | 5000 | 2800 |
| Seated Banquet Package | 950 | 12000 | 6500 |
| Gala Reception Package | 2200 | 28000 | 14500 |
| Multi-Day Conference Residency Package | 5800 | 75000 | 42000 |

## Boundary illustrations on the Seated Banquet Package

| Food and beverage value standing on the booking entry | Room hire standing in the contracted value |
| --- | --- |
| 12000 | None, the waiver spend being reached |
| 11999 | 950, the value sitting above the minimum spend |
| 6500 | 950, the minimum spend being reached exactly |
| 6499 | 950 together with 1, that is 951 |
| 4000 | 950 together with 2500, that is 3450 |

The waiver is read first, so a value at or above the waiver spend leaves no room hire whatever the minimum spend says; and the top-up in the second case is the whole difference between the minimum spend and the value standing, never a part of it.
